The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `8529` (see `ArangoDbBuilder.ArangoDbPort`)
- Environment variable: `ARANGO_ROOT_PASSWORD=root` (see `ArangoDbBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Wait strategy: Waits until a message matching `Have fun!` is logged.
